name: Goodnight Gas Pipeline
monitor_reason: no data center tie: no source names this pipeline and links it to a data center, and the line is about 2.4 km, under the 25 km floor
researcher_notes: The line is real. A Texas Railroad Commission construction report from December 2025 lists Abilene DC 1, LLC, Goodnight Gas Pipeline, Armstrong County, 1.5 miles, 20 inch, natural gas transmission, new system, start date March 2026. A Railroad Commission operator list from September 2026 also shows the Goodnight Gas Pipeline under the same operator. Neither document mentions data centers. The operator is the Crusoe entity that owns the Abilene campus, while the Goodnight campus in Armstrong County is filed under a different entity, GN DC1, LLC. Press on the Goodnight campus describes a 933 MW on-site gas plant but never names this pipeline. Two more searches found no source linking this line to the campus. The tie is a reasonable guess from the name and county, but it is not sourced, so DataCenter stays blank. Not an existing row: P8318 is Energy Transfer's Abilene laterals. Revisit if a filing, permit or press item names the Goodnight Gas Pipeline as the campus gas supply. If it does, stage it as a new row with Owner Abilene DC 1, LLC, length 1.5 mi, diameter 20 in, status construction, and no route.
